import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

@triton.jit
def _layernorm_kernel(X_ptr, Y_ptr, N, eps, stride_xm, stride_xn, stride_ym, stride_yn, BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr):
    row = tl.program_id(0)
    x_base = X_ptr + row * stride_xm
    y_base = Y_ptr + row * stride_ym
    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    mask = offs < N
    x = tl.load(x_base + offs * stride_xn, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    mean = tl.sum(x, axis=0) / N
    x_centered = x - mean
    var = tl.sum(x_centered * x_centered, axis=0) / N
    rstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps)
    y = x_centered * rstd
    tl.store(y_base + offs * stride_yn, y.to(Y_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)

def kernel(X, Y, N, eps, stride_xm, stride_xn, stride_ym, stride_yn):
    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(N)
    grid = (X.shape[0],)
    _layernorm_kernel[grid](X, Y, N, eps, stride_xm, stride_xn, stride_ym, stride_yn, BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE)
